prompt:
Create ONE square game sprite atlas with EXACTLY ONE HUNDRED individual fantasy RPG item icons. Strict invisible 10 columns by 10 rows equal-cell grid; exactly 100 objects in reading order. Canvas ideally 2048x2048. These are provisional placeholder icons; prioritize broad distinct silhouettes and accurate item identities. Colorful polished stylized 3D fantasy MMORPG inventory art. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background everywhere between objects. NO frames, no visible grid, no tile backgrounds, no text, no labels, no numbers. Every single object must be centered fully inside its cell, filling no more than 70% of cell width/height with clear transparent padding on all sides. Do not let objects overlap or cross boundaries. Individual weapons only: sword is ONE sword, shield is ONE shield, no paired or combined equipment. Breastplates only without human body. Exact required row-major contents:
